title: Bosses' Rise Rebalanced
description: Makes the dragon bone set more balanced for big modpacks.
body: This datapack rebalances the Dragon Bone Armor in the Bosses' Rise mod. The Dragon Bone armor in the mod is basically equal to diamond with a few other effects, making it not really worth it to get in huge modpacks with mods like Ice and Fire midgame, this makes the Dragon Bone Armor a bit better than dragon scale by giving it Resistance 1 if you have the full set equipped.
